modes.name: Bluetooth (classic)
modes.notes: A paired controller pages its host. The packets carry the host's address, so one entry (the BC-250's) covers every controller paired with it, and any other paired device that reconnects by itself, such as a headset. Detection and wake were tested on a spare board; the test in the case is pending.
modes.how_to_add: Wake method 2.4G, Bluetooth hosts: type the BC-250's Bluetooth address (bluetoothctl show on the BC-250), or Learn while switching the controller on.
